title: The verifier finds a deadlock
text: Two workers each need `lockA` and `lockB`, but `grabA` takes `lockA` first and `grabB` takes `lockB` first. Asked whether the net is deadlock free with `lockA`, `lockB` and `done` as sink places, the verifier enumerates the 8 reachable state classes and answers `Violated` with the trace `grabA`, `grabB`. The steps below are that trace, replayed by the Lean reference.

steps.text: The second worker takes `lockB`. This is the end of the verifier's trace.

The transition `finishA` needs `lockB`, which the second worker holds; `finishB` needs `lockA`, which the first holds. Nothing is enabled, and tokens rest in `holdsA` and `holdsB`, which are not sinks: a deadlock.
